study_design: Prospective nested case-control study within the Japan Collaborative Cohort Study
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Of 14,105 male subjects of the cohort who donated their sera, 52 cases and 151 controls were identified.
reason: The abstract evaluates prostate cancer risk among men followed after serum collection and reports no stage-, grade-, metastatic-, or lethality-defined incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The odds ratio (OR) for the highest level to the lowest was 0.38 (95% confidence interval (CI); 0.13, 1.13) for genistein, 0.41 (0.15, 1.11) for daidzein, and 0.34 (0.11, 1.10) for equol for the second dataset.
estimate_classifications.reason: The genistein estimate is for general prostate cancer in the second analytic dataset, not for aggressive disease.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
